Event_Code.definition: Sampling event code. Concatenation of park code, hexagon ID, station ID, and sampling date.

Station.definition: ID of original randomly selected sampling station

Quadrat_Ltr.definition: Quadrat label A, B, C, or D

Species.definition: Scientific name of seagrass species observed
